subject: 2016 Mustang Hall of Fame Inductee Interviews
overview: The Mustang Hall of Fame interviewed several 2016 inductees to recognize their athletic achievements and community service at Medford High School. Inductees shared personal histories, reflected on the impact of coaches and mentors, and provided advice for current student-athletes.

items.title: Introduction to the 2016 Induction Class
items.summary: President Dave Crowley announced the induction of 13 individuals into the Mustang Hall of Fame, scheduled for November 20, 2016.

items.title: Interview with Dave Crowley
items.summary: Dave Crowley discussed his multi-sport background as a catcher and credited the personal connections made through Medford High sports with his admission to Harvard University.

items.title: Interview with Dave and Meg Richard
items.summary: Siblings Dave and Meg Richard reflected on their respective careers in football, track, and softball, and the significance of being inducted into the Hall of Fame together.

items.title: Interview with Coach Egerio
items.summary: Coach Egerio recounted highlights from his 46-year coaching career, his role in establishing the city's Junior Olympics, and the lessons of commitment taught through cross-country running.

items.title: Interview with Kayla Sherry
items.summary: Kayla Sherry discussed the importance of female athletes supporting one another and how her experiences in basketball and track prepared her for collegiate athletics at Wellesley College.

items.title: Interview with Al Uwango
items.summary: Al Uwango described founding the Medford Youth Soccer program to provide local opportunities for children and his transition to coaching varsity girls soccer.

items.title: Interview with Greg Wilson
items.summary: Greg Wilson discussed his family's legacy within the Hall of Fame and how the blue-collar work ethic he developed playing hockey and baseball translated to his professional career.
